question: For load balancers provided by “haproxy”, list only those whose bytes in are above the average bytes in across all “haproxy” load balancers; return the load balancer name, VIP address, bytes in, total connections, and the same row number window (ordered by load balancer name with a frame of 2 preceding and 1 following rows). Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH haproxy_lbs AS (
  SELECT 
    lb.name AS loadbalancer_name,
    lb.vip_address AS vip_address,
    stats.bytes_in AS bytes_in,
    stats.total_connections AS total_connections
  FROM lbaas_loadbalancers lb
  JOIN providerresourceassociations pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id
  JOIN lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics stats ON lb.id = stats.loadbalancer_id
  WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy'
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT 
    loadbalancer_name,
    vip_address,
    bytes_in,
    total_connections,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY loadbalancer_name ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS row_number
  FROM haproxy_lbs
),
avg_bytes AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_in) AS avg_bytes_in
  FROM haproxy_lbs
)
SELECT 
  w.loadbalancer_name AS name,
  w.vip_address AS vip_address,
  w.bytes_in AS bytes_in,
  w.total_connections AS total_connections,
  w.row_number AS row_number
FROM windowed w
CROSS JOIN avg_bytes a
WHERE w.bytes_in > a.avg_bytes_in
ORDER BY w.loadbalancer_name
